<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="IEUCJ6CBqFHTVZJpmTTM"> <mxGraphModel dx="2060" dy="24" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml
title System Use-Case Workflow

skinparam backgroundColor white
skinparam shadowing false
skinparam defaultFontName Arial

rectangle \"User\" as user

rectangle \"AI Query Processing System\" as system {

 rectangle \"Submit Query\" as submit

 rectangle \"Retrieve Knowledge\" as retrieve

 rectangle \"Verify Information\" as verify {
 rectangle \"Verify Facts\" as facts
 rectangle \"Verify Citations\" as citations
 rectangle \"Check Logic /\nContradictions\" as logic
 }

 rectangle \"Evaluate Reliability\" as evaluate

 rectangle \"Self-Repair /\nRefine Response\" as repair

 rectangle \"Generate Response\" as generate

 rectangle \"View Final Response\" as final

 rectangle \"View Confidence /\nEvaluation\" as confidence
}

user --> submit
submit --> retrieve

retrieve --> facts
retrieve --> citations
retrieve --> logic

facts --> evaluate
citations --> evaluate
logic --> evaluate

evaluate --> generate : Reliable
evaluate --> repair : Unreliable

repair --> retrieve : Re-retrieve

generate --> final
final --> confidence

@enduml",
 "config": null
